title: Fix Window Option Toggle Active Fill Width
description: Active window option toggles don't show the active color for the full width of the tree item — the fill is cut partway through. Fix windowMeasureToggleClass so toggle items stretch across the full measure tree row.
summary: Window option measure toggles used `w-auto shrink-0` on toggle-group items, so the active (`bg-active-base`) fill only covered the label width instead of the full tree row. Updated `windowMeasureToggleClass` to force `!w-full` on the group and `!flex-1 !aspect-auto !shrink` on items via descendant selectors. Added a regression test in `WindowMeasuresTree`.
